# Agentic Intelligence System - LLMs Discovery

This file lists the active AI coding agents, skills, and safety boundaries configured for the workstation/organization.

## Active Workstation
- Machine: Yoga Laptop Workstation (Windows)
- Specifications: RAM 16GB, Parallel session capacity 5

## Coding Agent Fleet

### Claude Code (`cl`)
- Primary LLM: `claude-3-5-sonnet`
- Specs: Context 200k in / 8k out, Latency: Medium
- Cost: $3/1M in, $15/1M out
- Strengths: Multi-file refactors, TDD loops, library upgrades
- Failure Modes: Context exhaustion on massive file reads, Prompt injection from web logs

### DeepAgent (dcode) (`da`)
- Primary LLM: `claude-3-5-sonnet`
- Specs: Context 200k in / 8k out, Latency: Slow
- Cost: $3/1M in, $15/1M out
- Strengths: Long-horizon tasks, multi-step planning, remote sandboxing
- Failure Modes: Loop timeouts in deep sub-agent delegation queues

### Cursor (`cur`)
- Primary LLM: `claude-3-5-sonnet`
- Specs: Context 100k in / 4k out, Latency: Fast
- Cost: $3/1M in, $15/1M out
- Strengths: Frontend UI layout, interactive visual edits
- Failure Modes: Write collisions with active editor states, File locking on Windows

### Codex CLI (`cd`)
- Primary LLM: `gpt-4o`
- Specs: Context 128k in / 4k out, Latency: Fast
- Cost: $5/1M in, $15/1M out
- Strengths: Standard developer tasks, security audits
- Failure Modes: Code hallucinations on newly released APIs

### OpenCode (`oa`)
- Primary LLM: `groq/llama-4-scout`
- Specs: Context 8k in / 2k out, Latency: Ultra-Fast
- Cost: $0/1M in, $0/1M out
- Strengths: Trivial configuration edits, speed-coding, and API testing
- Failure Modes: Inability to ingest large repositories due to context size limits

### Antigravity (agy) (`ay`)
- Primary LLM: `gemini-1.5-pro`
- Specs: Context 1000k in / 8k out, Latency: Medium-Fast
- Cost: $1.25/1M in, $3.75/1M out
- Strengths: High-velocity OS & creator workspace operations, cross-repo sync
- Failure Modes: Output style drift (requires strict system prompt constraints)

## Global Skills Registry

### agent-manager-skill (v1.0.0)
- Triggers: `coding agent`, `route agent`, `handoff`, `machine status`
- Description: Orchestrate, route, monitor, and hand off between AI coding agents on this workstation.
- Priority: high

### model-routing (v1.0.0)
- Triggers: `model`, `routing`, `optimize`, `cost`
- Description: Intelligent model selection - routes tasks to Haiku, Sonnet, or Opus based on task complexity analysis.
- Priority: high

## Repositories Harness & Safety Policies

### Repository: `Starlight-Intelligence-System`
- Risk Level: `production`
- Stance: Global hooks active
- Verification: run `pnpm test` to verify health.
- Deployment Policy: `manual`

### Repository: `agentic-creator-os`
- Risk Level: `production`
- Stance: Scoped local harness only
- Verification: run `pnpm test` to verify health.
- Deployment Policy: `manual`

### Repository: `FrankX`
- Risk Level: `private`
- Stance: Scoped local harness only
- Verification: run `npm run health` to verify health.
- Deployment Policy: `none`

### Repository: `frankx.ai-vercel-website`
- Risk Level: `production`
- Stance: Scoped local harness only
- Verification: run `pnpm build && pnpm start` to verify health.
- Deployment Policy: `vercel-main`
